items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 25 October 2026 4:02am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Sunday, 25 October 2026 at 4:00am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

There's a Severe Gale Warning in operation, occasionally Storm force at first, becoming a Gale Warning for this afternoon.


##Synopsis##

Very deep low (Storm Boelo) near northern Scotland, slowly moving towards southern Norway.


##Wind##

West gale 8 or severe gale 9, occasionally storm 10 in places at first. Slowly decreasing 7 or gale 8 this afternoon, then gradually 6 or 7 during the evening. Backing southwest 4 or 5 overnight.


##State of Sea##

Rough or very rough, becoming moderate or rough later today, then slight or moderate overnight.


##Weather##

Showers becoming isolated.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in showers.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Southwest 4 or 5, backing southeast 5 to 7 during Monday morning, veering south or southwest 6 or 7 during the afternoon, then increasing 7 or gale 8 in the evening.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate at first, soon becoming moderate or rough, then rough or very rough later on Monday.


##Weather##

Rain soon spreading from the southwest, becoming mostly fair for a while in the afternoon, then rain again later in the day, clearing overnight.


##Visibility##

Good, becoming moderate or poor in the rain.
